mapper.select: SELECT id, role_name AS roleName FROM `role` ORDER BY id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT r.id FROM role r LEFT JOIN users u ON JSON_CONTAINS ( u.role, CONVERT ( r.id, CHAR ) ) WHERE 1=1
AND r.role_name LIKE '%${roleName}%'
GROUP BY r.id ) AS temp
SELECT u.id FROM role r JOIN users u ON JSON_CONTAINS ( u.role, CONVERT ( r.id, CHAR ) ) WHERE r.id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE role SET role_name=#{roleName}, `desc`=#{desc}, permissions=#{permissions} WHERE id=#{id} AND id!=0
